title: PR 93's table: the two left-end rules proved in Coq
text: For 1RB1RA_1LC0RD_1LD1LB_1LE0LF_0RA---_0LB0LF, the run uses two rules at the left end of the tape besides busycoq pull request 93's 21 macro rules; both are now proved in Coq for all parameters. After its first 12 steps the run stays on these 23 rules (3 million macro steps checked), so a halt would need them to get stuck away from the left end. Invariant searches up to about 60 million abstract states found no stuck shape but did not close.
